display_name: Meesho formula pattern — Forward GMV Summary
formula_text:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', created_date) AS month,
  COUNT(*) AS orders,
  SUM(charged_amount) AS gmv,
  SUM(charged_amount_excluding_tax) AS taxable_value,
  SUM(total_tax) AS product_tax,
  SUM(freight_charge) AS shipping,
  SUM(freight_charge_gst) AS shipping_gst,
  SUM(tcs_taxable_amount) AS tcs_base
FROM zs_observe.meesho_sales
WHERE is_active = true
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
